facts.fact: Ecofin Agency reports on 26 October 2026 that Burkina Faso signed roaming agreements with Benin, Cote d'Ivoire and Senegal on 23 October 2026 in Ouagadougou.

Ecofin Agency reports on 26 October 2026 that Cote d'Ivoire's regulator says the roaming agreement with Ghana, launched 14 June 2023, cut charges for Ivorian subscribers in Ghana by as much as 90 per cent.
